conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hi, I can’t log into my savings account online. It keeps saying ‘invalid credentials’!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the trouble Sir. Have you tried resetting your password using the ‘Forgot Password’ link?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Yeah, I did that, but I’m not getting the OTP on my phone!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Let’s verify your registered mobile number. Can you confirm the number linked to your account?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s nine seven zero four five six nine nine six. This is so annoying, I need to transfer money today!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I understand. It seems the OTP system is delayed. I’ll manually reset your access and send a temporary password. You’ll get it in 10 minutes.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Alright, thanks. Please make sure it works.
